incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: canary 'embedder-v2' error_rate=7.2% (5m) in eu-west-1 > alert threshold 5%. Rule: canary-deploy-error-rate. Affected endpoint: /v1/embeddings. Errors observed: 502/504, latency nominal. @Maya (oncall) tagged.

Maya (oncall): Acked. Joining. Who pushed the canary and what's in it?

Tasha (eng-runtime): That was the 2026-03-15 03:05 UTC canary rollout (PR #4892). We enabled feature flag `use-embedder-v2` for 10% traffic scoped to eu-west-1. Diff: kernel selection tweak + KV cache refactor for quantized path.

Raj (SRE): Logs show 502 spikes; stack traces during embedder warmup show NPE in kv_cache.fetch. Sample: 
```
2026-03-15T03:07:12Z ERROR embedder:init failed: nil pointer deref
  runtime.go:312
  kv_cache.go:78
```

Maya (oncall): Ok. Since it's canary-scoped, can we reduce the flag to 0% quickly? That would be less disruptive than a rollback.

Tasha (eng-runtime): Yes. Feature flags are in featureflag-service. Quick curl to set perc to 0 for the canary bucket: 
```
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/use-embedder-v2" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_ADMIN" \\n  -d '{"set_percentage":0,"scope":"eu-west-1:canary"}'
```

Ben (prodops): If the flag toggle succeeds, hold off on rollback. If it fails or errors persist >5m, execute rollback plan.

Maya (oncall): I'm flipping the flag now. Will report back in this thread.

Maya (oncall): Flag change response: 200 OK. `use-embedder-v2` set_percentage=0 for eu-west-1:canary. Audit id ff-change-20260315-1. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Recorded: feature flag update ff-change-20260315-1.

Raj (SRE): Metrics: error rate falling — 5m window down to 2.1%, instant at 0.6%. Latency unchanged. Looks limited to embedder-v2 invocation paths.

Tasha (eng-runtime): Logs confirm fewer init NPEs post-toggle. Early diagnosis: kernel selection returned nil for some quantized model shapes during init; missing defensive checks. I'll prepare a revert and fixes.

Maya (oncall): Marking mitigated for now. incident-bot, please auto-resolve if error rate stays below threshold for 15 minutes. I'll stay on thread for 20 minutes then handover.

incident-bot: Acknowledged. Will monitor and resolve after 15m stable window. Next automated check in 5m.

Tasha (eng-runtime): I'll open PRs: one to revert the kernel-selection tweak (#4901) and one to add nil checks + unit tests (#4902). Also adding an integration to exercise quantized shapes.

Raj (SRE): Suggestion: add a canary-specific warmup/healthcheck endpoint for embedders so we can catch init NPEs before routing traffic. Adding to backlog and will prioritize after RCA.

Ben (prodops): Add playbook entry: auto-kill-switch at 4% error for 3m (current was 5%/5m). Also note prepared rollback command if toggle fails: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embedder-canary --namespace=prod-eu-west --to-revision=20260314-3`.

Maya (oncall): Creating incident ticket and timeline now. Postmortem draft requested: Tasha, include root cause, immediate remediation, and CI/test changes.

Tasha (eng-runtime): Will draft postmortem. Immediate actions: revert tweak, add nil guards, extend canary shape test coverage.

Maya (oncall): Handoff plan: will hand to Zoe for next shift (09:00-17:00 eu-west). Zoe, please monitor the alert and the ticket.

Zoe (oncall): Ack. I'll watch the metrics and update ticket if anything changes. Please paste the postmortem link once available.

incident-bot: Auto-check +5m: error rate steady at 0.4% (< threshold). Alert remains acknowledged until 15m stable window completes.

Raj (SRE): Note for follow-up: add explicit telemetry for embedder init failures to make root-cause triage faster (tag by kernel selection path).

Tasha (eng-runtime): PRs opened: #4901 revert, #4902 nil-checks. Coordinating with QA to validate before any further canary changes.
